data.one_liner: A testing library for Blocs and Cubits utilizing BlocPresentationMixin.
data.what_it_does: Provides utility functions and mock classes to test presentation streams in Blocs and Cubits that use the BlocPresentationMixin. It offers approaches like whenListenPresentation and MockPresentationBloc to facilitate stream testing.
use_when: You are testing Blocs or Cubits that use the bloc_presentation package
You need to verify presentation events emitted by your state management components
avoid_when: You are not using the bloc_presentation package in your app
You are using a different state management approach like Riverpod or Provider
strengths: Simplifies testing of presentation streams with mock utilities
Integrates well with mocktail and bloc testing workflows
weaknesses: Strictly tied to the bloc_presentation package ecosystem
Limited usefulness outside of specific mixin-based Bloc architectures
data.setup_notes: Add the package as a dev dependency in pubspec.yaml.

alternatives.name: bloc_test
alternatives.why_pick_it: Standard testing library for the bloc ecosystem covering core bloc and cubit testing.
